properties.name: When the same thing is held in a reflow2 design and somewhere else — another design, the codebase, StoryFlow — the two are joined by an identity link that says who asserts it, a question can follow the link, and identity is never held only as text
properties.source: Anthony, 2026-09-28, in a dev_reflow2 session: "what is applicable to reflow2 and storyflow from the 5 tests? If we need to apply things to reflow2 and storyflow, then please add them to their respective design graphs also." Test 5 of dec:what-a-true-knowledge-graph-is (graph-primitives design on flo2, graph 85a2a1a36e7c942d), accepted on his word the same day.
properties.statement:
Test 5 of the accepted definition of a true knowledge graph (graph-primitives design on flo2: dec:what-a-true-knowledge-graph-is), applied to reflow2.

Baseline @ 4659832b: 15 identity relationships exist (aliases, handle, mirror_of + mirror_content_hash between designs, Artifact location + checksum to files, version, snapshots). A design already links to its codebase and to mirrored designs (req:linking-two-projects-is-a-served-process, req:design-composes); nothing links a reflow2 design to a StoryFlow graph; and whether a question can follow every identity link has not been measured.

Required: every identity reflow2 records is a link, never only a name in prose or a string field; it says who asserts the identity and on what basis; and a question can follow it into the other design or graph (composed analysis, req:composed-analysis). Met when a check over every identity-bearing field and edge finds each one a followable link with an asserter.
